column1: # alias
# 2026-05-28 — host_port now equals container_port for HTTP services.
# Earlier scheme used host_port=80 to give Mac dialing port-free URLs (e.g.,
# `http://litellm:4000`), but OrbStack collapses all port-80 bindings into one
# `*:80` wildcard listener (verified via lsof) so multiple services on
# port 80 of different 127.0.10.x IPs all routed to whichever container
# was registered first. OrbStack does honor specific-IP binds for non-80
# ports, so using each service's native port works.
# Mac and container side now use the SAME URL form:
#   http://litellm:4000  (both sides)
#   http://phoenix:6006  (both sides)
#   redis://falkordb:6379  (both sides)
# 2026-06-21 — the OPT-IN host ingress (Phase 31; `mayssam-ai-stack.sh ingress up`)
# ADDS port-free Mac-browser URLs http://litellm/ + https://litellm/ on top of
# the above, via a host-native Caddy that binds each service's OWN
# 127.0.10.x:80/:443 (a HOST process, NOT a docker --publish — so it sidesteps
# the OrbStack *:80 wildcard described above). name:port + container URLs are
# unchanged. HTTP rows on a 127.0.10.x IP get a site; redis/grpc + 127.0.0.1
# rows are excluded. Spec: doc/specs/2026-06-21-bare-hostname-ingress.md
# 2026-06-29 — `mayssam-ai-stack.sh ingress add <name> <port>` registers a NEW port-free
# http://name/ for any host server bound to 127.0.0.1:<port> (e.g. a *-serve viewer),
# WITHOUT modifying that server. It appends a row with protocol `http-loopback`: the host
# Caddy binds the alias 127.0.10.x:80/:443 and reverse-proxies to 127.0.0.1:<port> with an
# upstream `header_up Host` rewrite (so a loopback Host-pin still passes). Such a row yields
# `name/` ONLY — NOT `name:port` (nothing binds the alias IP). `ingress list` shows every
# hostname + all URL forms + reachability + bind posture; `ingress remove <name>` reverses an
# `add`. Activate/teardown either via `sudo prepare-sudo` + `sudo ingress reload`.
# `ingress add` rows do NOT land HERE — they go to the gitignored `aliases.local.tsv`
# (personal, never committed to the public repo). aliases_load merges that file ON TOP of
# this one; a local row reusing a name here OVERRIDES it. This file stays the shared table.

# NOTE — openwork/aionui (above) get a NAMED alias mapped to 127.0.0.1 (their actual
#        loopback bind) so the Mac browses http://openwork:8787/ui instead of the raw IP.
#        They use 127.0.0.1 (NOT a 127.0.10.x alias) because the daemons bind 127.0.0.1;
#        the lo0-bind step + doctor checks 19/20 skip 127.0.0.1 by design.
#        agentscope-studio (Phase 33, opt-in via AGENTSCOPE_STUDIO=1) also uses a
#        127.0.0.1 alias, BUT note its server actually binds 0.0.0.0 (the upstream
#        host:'localhost' default is inert) — the loopback posture relies on the box
#        not being exposed, NOT on the bind. Studio also opens an OTLP gRPC trace
#        RECEIVER on :4318 (not aliased; sims export to http://127.0.0.1:4318).
#        4318 (NOT 4317): phoenix-otlp (line 25) already owns :4317 and as_studio binds
#        0.0.0.0, so :4317 would collide with / hijack Phoenix's OTLP intake.
# The following host services stay INTENTIONALLY alias-free (reached at localhost:PORT):
#   • claw3d UI (:4310)     — claw3d REFUSES to bind a public host without
#                             STUDIO_ACCESS_TOKEN (its own security), so it binds
#                             127.0.0.1; reach it at http://localhost:4310.
#   • claw3d-bridge (:7780) — auth-less + can drive all 9 agents → loopback by design.
#   • lmstudio (:1234)      — reached from the LiteLLM CONTAINER, so host-gateway
#                             (host.docker.internal), not a host lo0 alias.
#   • understand-mcp (:7081)— reached from the fleet CONTAINERS via host.docker.internal
#                             (token-gated) — same pattern as lmstudio; no host lo0 alias.
# On-demand host VIEWERS (no alias by design; reach at localhost:PORT, or give one with
# `ingress add`): tutorial-serve (:8899), models-serve (:8898), fleet-studio (:8975),
# understand-dashboard (Vite). models/tutorial Host-pin to loopback; fleet-studio needs an
# https:// secure context — so `ingress add` for those wants https://name/ + `ingress trust`.
